name: Auto: Cryo Resonance
description: When the battle begins: If you have at least 1 Cryo character on your side, the opposing side takes +1 DMG during this match. If you have at least 3 Cryo characters on your side, gain an additional +1 DMG. (This effect is doubled from the fourth battle onwards)
